answer: A sponsor locks a 70-credit bond per identity, decaying 10% an epoch to a zero horizon. Each epoch the sponsor flashes a lantern attestation of fresh work and tops up; a missed lantern or caught fake burns it. One caught fake sends a ripple through the book: all twenty burn, capping books at twenty. A fake costs 70 locked, 45 per epoch; 1,000 cost 70,000 and 45,000 an epoch against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep their bond.
